tools.name: spyfu_get_domain_stats
tools.description: Latest SEO and PPC stats of a domain: monthly organic clicks, paid clicks, budget, ranking keywords, strength. Use past_n_months for more months. SpyFu bills the account for each row returned, so keep page_size small. API: GET domain_stats_api/v2/getLatestDomainStats.

tools.name: spyfu_get_domain_stats_history
tools.description: Monthly SEO and PPC stats of a domain for all months SpyFu has (many rows, billed per row). Prefer spyfu_get_domain_stats unless you need the full history. API: GET domain_stats_api/v2/getAllDomainStats.

tools.name: spyfu_get_domain_stats_for_month
tools.description: SEO and PPC stats of a domain for one month (yyyy-mm). API: GET domain_stats_api/v2/getDomainStatsForExactDate.

tools.name: spyfu_get_bulk_domain_stats
tools.description: SEO and PPC stats for up to 20 domains in one call (comma-separated). By default only the latest month per domain. API: GET domain_stats_api/v2/getBulkDomainStats.

tools.name: spyfu_find_matching_domains
tools.description: Find domains that match a search phrase, with traffic, budget and strength figures. SpyFu bills the account for each row returned, so keep page_size small. API: GET domain_stats_api/v2/getMatchingDomains.

tools.name: spyfu_get_top_competitors
tools.description: Top competitor domains by keyword overlap. channel: seo, ppc or combined. SpyFu bills the account for each row returned, so keep page_size small. API: GET competitors_api/v2/<channel>/getTopCompetitors.

tools.name: spyfu_get_competing_keywords
tools.description: Keywords that several domains rank or advertise for (overlap) or that only the first domain has (is_intersection false and exclude_domains set). channel: seo or ppc. SpyFu bills the account for each row returned, so keep page_size small. API: GET keyword_api/v2/kombat/getCompeting<Seo|Ppc>Keywords.

tools.name: spyfu_get_seo_keywords
tools.description: Organic keywords a domain ranks for, with rank, search volume, clicks and cost. search_type picks the view: MostValuable, NewlyRanked, GainedRanks, LostRanks, GainedClicks, LostClicks, JustMadeIt (reached top 10), JustFellOff (left top 10). SpyFu bills the account for each row returned, so keep page

tools.name: spyfu_get_outranking_keywords
tools.description: Organic keywords where domain ranks above compare_domain (search_type TheyOutrankYou) or where domain just passed compare_domain (TheyJustSurpassedYou). SpyFu bills the account for each row returned, so keep page_size small. API: GET serp_api/v2/seo/getOrganicOutrankingKeywords.

tools.name: spyfu_get_top_pages
tools.description: Top organic pages of a domain by estimated traffic (search_type MostTraffic) or newly ranking pages (New). SpyFu bills the account for each row returned, so keep page_size small. API: GET serp_api/v2/seo/getTopPages.

tools.name: spyfu_get_serp_analysis
tools.description: The organic results (domains, ranks, traffic, strength) for one keyword. Returns up to 105 rows by default; set page_size low. API: GET serp_api/v2/seo/getSerpAnalysisKeywords.

tools.name: spyfu_get_ranking_history
tools.description: Rank changes of a domain between two dates. query_type: MostValuable, FellFromTop10, MadeTheTop10, NewKeywords, NoLongerRanks, GainedRanks, LostRanks, GainedClicks, LostClicks. SpyFu bills the account for each row returned, so keep page_size small. API: GET organic_history_api/v2/historic/getHistori

tools.name: spyfu_get_keyword_information
tools.description: Search volume, difficulty, cost per click and clicks for up to 20 given keywords. Billed per keyword row. API: GET keyword_api/v2/related/getKeywordInformation.

tools.name: spyfu_get_related_keywords
tools.description: Keyword ideas for a seed keyword. type: related (default), questions, transactions, also_ranks_for, also_buys_ads_for, phrase_match. SpyFu bills the account for each row returned, so keep page_size small. API: GET keyword_api/v2/related/getRelatedKeywords or getKeywordExpansions.

tools.name: spyfu_get_ppc_keywords
tools.description: Keywords a domain buys ads for. kind: most_successful (default) or new. SpyFu bills the account for each row returned, so keep page_size small. API: GET keyword_api/v2/ppc/getMostSuccessful or getNewKeywords.

tools.name: spyfu_get_paid_serps
tools.description: Search result pages where a domain showed ads, with ad position and count. SpyFu bills the account for each row returned, so keep page_size small. API: GET serp_api/v2/ppc/getPaidSerps.

tools.name: spyfu_get_domain_ad_history
tools.description: Ads (copy, position, keywords) a domain ran in search results over time. Rows are costly (about $3 per 1000). SpyFu bills the account for each row returned, so keep page_size small. API: GET cloud_ad_history_api/v2/domain/getDomainAdHistory.

tools.name: spyfu_get_term_ad_history
tools.description: Ads that ran for one keyword over time, with the advertisers. Rows are costly (about $3 per 1000). SpyFu bills the account for each row returned, so keep page_size small. API: GET cloud_ad_history_api/v2/term/getTermAdHistory.

tools.name: spyfu_get_api_usage
tools.description: Rows used and cost of the SpyFu API for a month (yyyy-mm), in total, by day or by method. API: GET accounts_api/v2/usage/month/{month}[/daily|/method].
